value.rationale: Wang’s new universal-formula unique-output construction raises exactly the question which partial functions and convergence-domain complexities it represents. The theorem gives the complete natural extensional class (computable selector minus c.e. erasures), the sharp entire difference-of-c.e. domain boundary, a uniform closure construction not implicit in weak-pca syntax, and a sharp totality/graph-complexity separation. These structural distinctions inform comparisons of competing application semantics and are not a recomputation of a known table or an arbitrary finite special case.
